subject: Technical sync: Hosted API integration deep-dive and demo planning
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@brightpath.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API - propose technical deep-dive + demo

Hi Anna,

Thanks again for the call last week — BrightPath's use cases (real-time clinical summaries + context-aware fetches) sound like a great fit for Redwood's hosted API. We'd like to schedule a focused technical deep-dive to cover integration patterns (SDK usage, streaming responses, and tool / function calling), token accounting, and operational knobs (batching, cache, quantization recommendations) so your engineers can validate architecture and latency targets.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 9:30–10:30am
- Tue Dec 1, 3:00–4:00pm
- Wed Dec 2, 10:00–11:00am

Attached is a short agenda + a sketch of the architecture areas we'd walk through. If none of those work, tell me a couple of windows and we'll accommodate.

Agenda (attached): high-level architecture, SDK livestream demo, function-calling examples, auth & keys, performance expectations, next steps / mutual action plan.

Best,
Karthik
Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachments: hosted-integration-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@brightpath.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API - propose technical deep-dive + demo

Hi Karthik — thanks for the note and the agenda. All of those topics look good. Quick ask: can you include a short section on streaming fallback behavior (how partial tokens are emitted and how retries are handled) and auth patterns for multi-tenant data isolation? Our infra lead (Iccar Ruiz) will likely join and cares about those two specifically.

Unfortunately the morning slot on Dec 1 is booked. The 3pm slot would work for me. Can you confirm timezone for the invite (we're PST). Also will you share an architecture diagram of the recommended client-server pattern before the call? That will help our security engineers triage.

Attendees from BrightPath: Anna Lopez, Iccar Ruiz (infra), Mina Patel (data).

Thanks,
Anna
Director, Platform Engineering — BrightPath Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@brightpath.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API - propose technical deep-dive + demo

Anna — great, 3:00pm PST on Tue Dec 1 works for us. I'll send a calendar invite.

We'll include a focused section on streaming semantics and retry/fallback patterns — Ava will cover SDK streaming and backpressure. Marissa will walk through auth patterns (token scoping, customer KMS options) and operational SLAs.

I'm attaching an updated architecture sketch (very high level) so your security folks have something to review before the meeting.

Proposed meeting owner / roles:
- Redwood: Marissa (auth/SLA), Ava (SDK/streaming demo), Karthik (PM + mutual action plan)
- BrightPath: Anna (platform), Iccar (infra), Mina (data)

Attachments: architecture-diagram-v2.png (image/png)

Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@brightpath.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API - propose technical deep-dive + demo

Hi Anna and team — joining the call in a few minutes with the updated slides. Quick notes for the agenda to make sure we hit the details you care about: 

1) Streaming behavior (10–15m)
- How the SDK surfaces partial tokens and events
- Client reconnection semantics and server-side replay using KV caches
- Backpressure strategies for high-concurrency clinical workloads

2) Auth & tenancy (10m)
- API key scoping, per-tenant role bindings, and optional mTLS for Private deployments
- KMS/HSM integration patterns for dedicated/private customers

3) Demo (20m)
- Live SDK demo: streaming generation, tool/function calls to a mock EHR lookup, and structured JSON outputs

4) Ops & SLOs (10m)
- Latency SLO targets, cold-start profiles, and batching knobs

I've uploaded the SLA factsheet and a couple diagrams to the invite. Zoom link is in the calendar.

Attachments: SLA-factsheet.pdf (application/pdf)

See you on the call — Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@brightpath.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Iccar Ruiz <iccar.ruiz@brightpath.health>, Mina Patel <mina.patel@brightpath.health>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API - propose technical deep-dive + demo

Thanks Marissa — agenda looks great and the diagrams are helpful. We're looking forward to the demo. Quick logistics: please mute-by-default for attendees, and can you share the recording and the slide deck afterwards? Iccar will ask a few security-specific clarifying questions early on.

Also adding our procurement contact on the follow up for RFP next steps: procurement@brightpath.health

Best,
Anna
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@brightpath.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API - propose technical deep-dive + demo

Hi Anna — thanks, confirmed. I'll cover the SDK streaming demo and leave 10 minutes for the EHR tool-calling walkthrough. We'll post the recording, slides, and sample snippets (curl + Python + JS SDK) to the invite notes and to a secure share afterward.

See you shortly — Ava
Principal Product Engineer — Redwood Inference
